title: SDG 16 和平、正義與健全制度
footer: Teacher Dom · SDG #16 Peace, Justice and Strong Institutions 和平、正義與健全制度

slides.eyebrow_en: Your school's name holds today's secret
slides.eyebrow_zh: 你們的校名，藏著今天的主題

strip.zh: 個全球目標，今天談第 16 個
年：榕樹爺爺的樹蔭屬於每個人

strip.en: voice each — and every one counts
strip.zh: 每人一個聲音，每一個都算數

lines.en: This is my third year of teaching in Changhua.
lines.zh: 這是我在彰化教書的第三年。

lines.en: Peace is not only about wars far away. It starts right here, in our classroom.
lines.zh: 和平不只是遠方的戰爭，它就從這間教室開始。

slides.ask_en: Today: fair and unfair, peaceful choices, and how to be an upstander.
slides.ask_zh: 今天要談：公平與不公平、和平的選擇，還有怎麼挺身而出。

slides.ask_en: Two schools, one ocean apart — and the same wish: a fair, peaceful classroom.
slides.ask_zh: 隔著一片海洋的兩間學校，有同一個願望：公平、和平的教室。

slides.q_en: Your school's name is Taiping (太平). What does it mean?
slides.q_zh: 你們的校名「太平」，是什麼意思？
slides.explain_en: Great peace! 太 means “great” and 平 means “peace.” Today's lesson has been in your school's name all along.
slides.explain_zh: 太平！「太」是很大，「平」是平安、和平。今天的主題，一直都在你們的校名裡。

prompts.en: Stand up if you have ever felt something was unfair.
prompts.zh: 曾經覺得某件事不公平的，站起來。

prompts.en: Stay standing if you said something about it.
prompts.zh: 你有把它說出來的，繼續站著。

prompts.en: Stay standing if someone listened to you.
prompts.zh: 有人認真聽你說的，繼續站著。

slides.punch_en: Justice starts when someone speaks up — and someone listens.
slides.punch_zh: 正義，從有人說出來、有人願意聽開始。

slides.body_en: Peace: people are safe. Justice: the rules are fair for everyone. Strong institutions: schools, courts and town halls that keep it that way — and listen to people.
slides.body_zh: 和平：大家都安全。正義：規則對每個人都公平。健全制度：學校、法院、公所這些地方，讓這一切維持下去，也願意聽人民的聲音。

slides.q_en: Your class needs a class leader. What is the FAIREST way to choose?
slides.q_zh: 班上要選班長。哪一種方法最公平？
slides.explain_en: Everyone votes, one vote each. That is how fair institutions work — from your classroom to the whole country.
slides.explain_zh: 大家投票、每人一票。公平的制度就是這樣運作的——從你們班，到整個國家。

slides.ask_en: Grandfather Banyan is over 100 years old. Its shade belongs to the whole school and the whole village — nobody is left out.
slides.ask_zh: 榕樹爺爺一百多歲了。它的樹蔭屬於全校、也屬於整個村子——沒有人被排除在外。

slides.note_en: Some of these don't use hands at all — think carefully!
slides.note_zh: 有幾個根本沒動手——想清楚喔！

slides.head_en: If 30 students from around the world were one class…
slides.head_zh: 如果把全世界的學生縮成一個 30 人的班…
slides.reveal_en: About 1 in 3 was bullied at school in the past month.
slides.reveal_zh: 大約每 3 個就有 1 個，上個月在學校被霸凌過。

slides.body_en: A bystander sees bullying and does nothing. An upstander does something: stand next to the person, say “Stop, that's not OK,” or tell a teacher. You don't have to be brave alone.
slides.body_zh: 旁觀者看到霸凌，什麼都不做。挺身而出的人會採取行動：站到對方身邊、說「停，這樣不對」，或去告訴老師。你不需要一個人勇敢。

slides.head_zh: 真的還假的？手比 ⭕ 或 ❌

items.en: Rules should be the same for everyone.
items.zh: 規則應該對每個人都一樣。
items.note_en: That's justice — no special rules for popular kids.
items.note_zh: 這就是正義——受歡迎的人也沒有特別待遇。

items.en: If I see bullying, staying quiet is the safest choice.
items.zh: 看到霸凌，不出聲最安全。
items.note_en: Silence helps the bully. Stand with the person, or tell an adult.
items.note_zh: 沉默只會幫到霸凌的人。站到對方身邊，或告訴大人。

items.en: Peace just means nobody is fighting.
items.zh: 和平就只是沒有人在打架。
items.note_en: Peace also means everyone feels safe, respected and included.
items.note_zh: 和平也代表每個人都覺得安全、被尊重、被接納。

items.en: In a fair vote, every vote counts the same.
items.zh: 公平的投票，每一票都一樣重要。
items.note_en: Popular or new, tall or small — one person, one vote.
items.note_zh: 受不受歡迎、是不是新同學、高或矮——都是一人一票。

slides.head_en: Big Kids Look After Little Kids
slides.body_en: On the first day of school, you — the sixth-graders — walked the new first-graders through five game stations. That is what a peaceful school looks like: the big ones look after the small ones.
slides.body_zh: 開學第一天，你們六年級陪著一年級新生闖了五個關卡。和平的學校就是這個樣子：大的照顧小的。

slides.q_en: One group always takes over the basketball court at recess. What is the BEST thing to do?
slides.q_zh: 下課時，總是同一群人霸佔籃球場。最好的做法是什麼？

options.en: Ask the class meeting for fair turns

slides.explain_en: Class meeting! Making fair rules together — that's a strong institution.
slides.explain_zh: 拿到班會討論！一起訂出公平的規則——這就是健全制度。

slides.prompt_en: If you could make ONE new rule to make our school fairer, what would it be?
slides.prompt_zh: 如果你可以訂一條讓學校更公平的新規則，你會訂什麼？
slides.sentence_en: One rule I would make is ______, because ______.
slides.time_en: One minute each. Then I will ask two of you.
slides.time_zh: 每人一分鐘。然後我會請兩位分享。

lines.en: In our class, everyone gets a turn.
lines.zh: 在我們班，每個人都有機會。

lines.en: We solve problems by talking, not fighting.
lines.zh: 我們用說的解決問題，不用打的。

lines.en: Every voice counts — even the quiet ones.
lines.zh: 每個聲音都算數——安靜的聲音也是。

slides.tip_en: One class, one promise — read it out loud together!
slides.tip_zh: 一個班，一個約定——一起大聲唸出來！

slides.note_en: Watch — and listen for three words: “every voice matters.”
slides.note_zh: 看的時候注意聽這句：“every voice matters”（每個聲音都重要）。

slides.head_en: 3 Things You Can Do This Week
slides.head_zh: 這週你可以做的 3 件事

items.en: Invite someone who is alone to join you — at lunch or at play.
items.zh: 邀請落單的同學加入你——午餐或下課都可以。

items.en: At your next class meeting, suggest one fair rule.
items.zh: 下次班會，提出一條公平的規則。

items.en: If you see bullying, stand with the person and tell a teacher.
items.zh: 看到霸凌，站到對方身邊，並告訴老師。

items.en: Don't be a bystander — be an upstander.
items.zh: 不要當旁觀者，要挺身而出。

slides.q_en: The SDG 16 icon shows a bird holding an olive branch. Which bird is it?
slides.q_zh: SDG 16 的圖示上，有一隻鳥銜著橄欖枝。是哪一種鳥？
slides.explain_en: A dove! A dove with an olive branch has meant peace for thousands of years. On the icon, it stands on a judge's gavel — the hammer that stands for justice.
slides.explain_zh: 鴿子！銜著橄欖枝的鴿子，幾千年來都代表和平。圖示上，牠站在法官的法槌上——法槌代表正義。

slides.body_en: Go to our School Tour page and find the Taiping Elementary column. No sign-up, no login — tell me one way you will make our school fairer.
slides.body_zh: 到我們網站的 School Tour 頁面，找到太平國小那一欄，免註冊、免登入，告訴我你會怎麼讓學校更公平。
slides.sentence_en: One way I will make our school fairer: ______.
slides.sentence_zh: 我讓學校更公平的一個方法：______。

slides.big_en:
Taiping means peace —
and peace starts with you.
slides.big_zh: 太平就是和平——而和平，從你開始。
